integrity: Claims are supported by a complete symbolic proof and independently replayable finite programs; finite checks do not prove the all-n statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for initially primitive four-cycles on labelled loopless complete graphs with nonnegative chips; not a transient or higher-period census. Uses an externally published nonclumpy-firing-pattern theorem; independent validation not performed. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: An opposite-phase obstruction and exact period-four energy bands on complete graphs
